ja: 昨日、同僚にランチに誘われたけど、断ったんだ。
en: A coworker invited me to lunch yesterday, but I said no.
alternatives: A coworker invited me to lunch yesterday, but I declined.
My coworker asked me to lunch yesterday, but I said no.
point: 「誘われた」は coworker を主語に invited me で言える

ja: 土曜の試合が終わったら、みんなでご飯を食べに行こうよ。
en: Let's all go get something to eat when the game ends on Saturday.
alternatives: When the game's over on Saturday, let's all go out to eat.
Let's all grab something to eat after Saturday's game finishes.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形 ends

ja: 金曜の夜に花火大会があるんだけど、一緒に行かない？
en: There's a fireworks show Friday night. Want to go together?
alternatives: There's a fireworks festival on Friday night. Do you want to go together?
There's a fireworks display Friday night. Do you want to come with me?
point: 「〜がある」は There's で始め、誘いは Want to 〜? で軽く

ja: たとえ少し遅れても、ぜひ今夜のパーティーには来てね。
en: Even if you're a little late, please come to the party tonight.
alternatives: Even if you're running a bit late, do come to the party tonight.
Please come to the party tonight, even if you're a little late.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、中身は現在形

ja: ずっと君をキャンプに誘おうと思ってたんだけど、来月空いてる？
en: I've been meaning to invite you to go camping. Are you free next month?
alternatives: I've been wanting to ask you to go camping. Are you free next month?
I've been meaning to ask you to come camping. Are you free next month?
point: 「ずっと〜しようと思ってた」は I've been meaning to

ja: 佐藤さん一家が今週末バーベキューを計画してるんだけど、あなたも来る？
en: The Satos are planning a barbecue this weekend. Do you want to come?
alternatives: The Satos are having a barbecue this weekend. Want to come?
The Satos are planning a barbecue this weekend. Are you coming too?
point: 計画中のことは進行形 are planning、気軽な誘いは Do you want to come?

ja: 今夜のパーティー、もう誘われた？
en: Have you been invited to tonight's party yet?
alternatives: Has anyone invited you to tonight's party yet?
Have you gotten an invitation to tonight's party yet?
point: 「もう〜された？」は Have you been + 過去分詞 + yet
